# fw_bridge MCP tool

> Inspect or dispatch to Fw's absorbed first/third-party subsystems (heretic, neon/REA, craft-libs, craft-anything, ghidra). Input schema, parameters and a…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-bridge/

Inspect or dispatch to Fw's absorbed first/third-party subsystems (heretic, neon/REA, craft-libs, craft-anything, ghidra).

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "fw_bridge",
    "arguments": {
      "subsystem": "heretic"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subsystem` | `string: heretic, neon, craft, ghidra` | yes | Subsystem name. |

## Input schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subsystem": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "heretic",
        "neon",
        "craft",
        "ghidra"
      ],
      "description": "Subsystem name."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "subsystem"
  ]
}
```
